Routine Descriptions

SRSCAN_HAPI_TEST_NETWORK

 [Next Routine] [List of Routines] 
FUNCTION:
  srscan_hapi_test_network

PURPOSE:
  Network tests for the riometer HAPI server (srscan_api_config's
  hapi_url, https://api.phys.ucalgary.ca/hapi by default) through the
  generic SPEDAS client hapi_load_data. Covers the informational
  endpoints (capabilities/catalog/info), loads of each dataset family
  (NORSTAR_RIOMETER_K0, NORSTAR_RIOMETER_K2, SWAN_HSR_K0 spectrogram
  with time-varying bins), parameters=/prefix=/suffix=, NaN fill
  handling, and clean failure for requests the server rejects.

  Unlike the offline and data tiers these tests need the network; every
  test SKIPs when the server cannot be reached. Reference values are
  pinned to archived intervals (2007-11-19 and 1989-03-10 at gill, HSR
  2026-01-25) -- a server-side reprocessing of those days would show up
  here as a value mismatch. Downloaded CSVs go to a scratch directory
  under IDL's temp dir, not the srs_canada data cache.

  Each test is a procedure in this file; the function at the bottom
  (same name as the file) returns the list of test names. Run with:
    IDL> srscan_test_run, srscan_hapi_test_network()
  or as part of the full suite via srscan_run_tests, /network.

(See projects/srs_canada/tests/srscan_hapi_test_network.pro)

SRSCAN_RUN_TESTS

 [Previous Routine] [Next Routine] [List of Routines] 
PROCEDURE:
  srscan_run_tests

PURPOSE:
  Run the srs_canada test suite and print a PASS/FAIL/SKIP line per
  test plus a summary. Tiers:
    offline: TREx RGB pure-logic tests, no network and no data cache
    data:    TREx RGB loader tests against the local cache for the
             reference night 2023-03-24 (run with /no_download; tests
             SKIP when the needed dataset is not cached)
    network: riometer HAPI server tests through hapi_load_data (opt-in
             via /network; tests SKIP when the server is unreachable)
  By default nothing touches the network, so the suite is deterministic
  and safe to run anywhere.

KEYWORDS:
  offline_only: run only the pure-logic tests
  data_only:    run only the cache-backed loader tests
  network:      also run the HAPI server tests (combines with
                /offline_only or /data_only)
  network_only: run only the HAPI server tests
  exit_status:  exit IDL when done with status 0 (all passed) or 1
                (failures), for batch/CI runs. CAUTION: Windows IDL
                does not honor EXIT's STATUS keyword (observed: always
                exit code 3, IDL 9.0) -- on Windows check the
                'RESULT: PASS/FAIL' line instead, or have the batch
                command write nfail= to a file (batch IDL on Windows
                can also drop the last buffered stdout lines at exit,
                so a results file is the most reliable option)
  npass, nfail, nskip, failed: (out) totals from srscan_test_run

EXAMPLES:
  IDL> srscan_run_tests
  IDL> srscan_run_tests, /offline_only
  IDL> srscan_run_tests, /network_only
  batch: idl -e "srscan_run_tests, /exit_status"

NOTES:
  Future instrument suites (THEMIS ASI, REGO, ...) can plug in here as
  extra test-list functions; the runner (srscan_test_run) is generic.
  The HAPI server URL comes from srscan_api_config (hapi_url), so
  SRSCAN_API_URL also points the network tier at a staging server.

(See projects/srs_canada/tests/srscan_run_tests.pro)

SRSCAN_TEST_ASSERT

 [Previous Routine] [Next Routine] [List of Routines] 
PROCEDURE:
  srscan_test_assert

PURPOSE:
  Minimal assertion for the srs_canada test suite: if condition is not
  true, throw an error (via MESSAGE) that the test runner
  (srscan_test_run) catches and records as a FAIL for the current test.

INPUT:
  condition: scalar truth value (arrays: element 0 is tested; combine
             array comparisons with array_equal/total first)
  msg:       description of what was being asserted, shown on failure

EXAMPLE:
  srscan_test_assert, n_elements(x) eq 3, 'expected 3 files'

(See projects/srs_canada/tests/srscan_test_assert.pro)

SRSCAN_TEST_RUN

 [Previous Routine] [Next Routine] [List of Routines] 
PROCEDURE:
  srscan_test_run

PURPOSE:
  Minimal, dependency-free test runner for the srs_canada project.
  Takes a list of test PROCEDURE names, runs each under a CATCH
  handler, and prints one PASS/FAIL/SKIP line per test plus a summary.

  A test fails by throwing any error -- normally via srscan_test_assert.
  A test skips by calling srscan_test_skip (unmet precondition, e.g.
  local test data not cached). A test that returns normally passes.

  The runner is deliberately generic (nothing TREx-specific): suites
  for other instruments (THEMIS ASI, REGO, ...) can reuse it as-is by
  passing their own test lists.

INPUT:
  tests: string array of test procedure names

KEYWORDS:
  title:  label used in the banner/summary lines
  npass:  (out) number of tests passed
  nfail:  (out) number of tests failed
  nskip:  (out) number of tests skipped
  failed: (out) names of the failed tests ('' if none)

EXAMPLE:
  srscan_test_run, srscan_trex_rgb_test_offline(), title = 'TREx RGB offline'

(See projects/srs_canada/tests/srscan_test_run.pro)

SRSCAN_TEST_SKIP

 [Previous Routine] [Next Routine] [List of Routines] 
PROCEDURE:
  srscan_test_skip

PURPOSE:
  Skip the current test: throws an error whose message carries this
  routine's name, which the test runner (srscan_test_run) recognizes and
  records as a SKIP rather than a FAIL. Use for tests whose
  preconditions are absent (e.g. local test data not cached) so the
  suite stays green on machines without the data.

EXAMPLE:
  if ~file_test(dir, /directory) then $
    srscan_test_skip, 'test data not in local cache'

(See projects/srs_canada/tests/srscan_test_skip.pro)

SRSCAN_TREX_RGB_TEST_DATA

 [Previous Routine] [Next Routine] [List of Routines] 
FUNCTION:
  srscan_trex_rgb_test_data

PURPOSE:
  Data-dependent tests for the srs_canada TREx RGB loaders. These run
  entirely offline (/no_download) against the local data cache for the
  reference test night 2023-03-24 (the aurora event used throughout the
  cribs); tests SKIP rather than fail when the needed dataset is not
  cached. Cache expectations:
    TREX_RGB_RAW_NOMINAL:    2023-03-24 ut06 (all sites; rabb also has
                             ut07 minute 0722 for the cross-hour test)
    TREX_RGB_HOURLY_KEOGRAM: 2023-03-24 ut01..ut10+ per site
    TREX_RGB_GRID_MOSV001:   2023-03-24 06:22
  A first run with downloads enabled populates the cache, e.g.:
    srscan_load_trex_rgb, site='gill', trange=['2023-03-24/06:00','2023-03-24/07:00'], /downloadonly

  Each test is a procedure in this file; the function at the bottom
  (same name as the file) returns the list of test names. Run with:
    IDL> srscan_test_run, srscan_trex_rgb_test_data()
  or as part of the full suite via srscan_run_tests.

(See projects/srs_canada/tests/srscan_trex_rgb_test_data.pro)

SRSCAN_TREX_RGB_TEST_OFFLINE

 [Previous Routine] [List of Routines] 
FUNCTION:
  srscan_trex_rgb_test_offline

PURPOSE:
  Offline (pure-logic) tests for the srs_canada TREx RGB routines: no
  network access and no local data cache required. Covers the archive
  filename window filter, gz dedup, the site table, keyword validation
  in the public loader, and the config reader.

  Each test is a procedure in this file; the function at the bottom
  (same name as the file) returns the list of test names, so calling it
  also compiles every test. Run with:
    IDL> srscan_test_run, srscan_trex_rgb_test_offline()
  or as part of the full suite via srscan_run_tests.

(See projects/srs_canada/tests/srscan_trex_rgb_test_offline.pro)
